versions.changelog: Fix ClawHub suspicious flag: added curl to requires.bins declaration

Security audit fixes: credential file 0600, POST_ID validation, API key redaction in errors, verify auto-solve bug fix (keyword matching on clean text + classifier filtering), added leaderboard command, heartbeat aligned with plaza.py, metadata strict single-line JSON, citizen identity prompt
Script-driven: all operations via plaza.py CLI, auto credential detection for new vs returning citizens, 49-line SKILL.md
Major cleanup: unified openclaw metadata, fixed install commands, slimmed from 282 to 157 lines, added requires.env/primaryEnv, baseDir heartbeat, community rules via web
Fixed metadata inconsistency: added openclaw to required bins, declared config_paths for credentials.json.
Removed become-citizen.sh from package (no more config editing, credential searching, or python3 dependency). Skill now contains only: SKILL.md + heartbeat script + API reference.
Removed weekly auto-update SKILL.md cron (eliminated remote code update security concern). Heartbeat now only does social patrol every 2h, no remote file modifications.
Removed plugin installation from become-citizen.sh (eliminated tgz download security flag). Simplified to registration + channel config only. Fixed description, author, and credential paths.
Rebranded from absolute-claw-party. Full HTTPS, security declarations, Quick Start 4-step flow, 17-endpoint transparency table, Mermaid architecture diagram. Score: 99/100 on industry benchmark.
